definitions.alpha: alpha_spy_pp = ret_pct - SPY return over the same entry and exit bars (SPY entered at the same open/close basis). alpha_sector_pp likewise against the sector ETF frozen with the rec.
definitions.calculation_2: New rules-4 episodes require the actual entry open/close and exact target-session closes. Missing prices are unresolved, never carried into a completed return. Missing terminal quotes do not imply liquidation value. Dividends remain excluded. Older numerical results retain calc-1; they are not silently recast as calc-2 evidence.
definitions.control: Same timing signal, but the name failed selection (control_conviction), is suspended (control_suspended) or is blocked by a name-specific gate leg (control_gate). Tracked identically.
definitions.corporate_actions: Both ends of every return come from ONE split-adjusted series pulled at calculation time, so a split between entry and exit cancels. Dividends are NOT included (price return), for the name and for both benchmarks alike.
definitions.correction: A frozen record is never edited. A correction is a NEW record in r17_corrections that names the record_sha256 it concerns and the reason; results may be recomputed (calc_version, prices_asof) but frozen fields and their hash may not change. effect=annotate: shown beside the record, statistics unchanged. effect=exclude_from_statistics: the episode stays in the list, is flagged excluded_from_statistics=true, and leaves every cohort and the equity curve. Corrections are themselves append-only and never edited.
definitions.costs: 10 basis points each way on the rec: ret = exit*(1-c) / (entry*(1+c)) - 1. Benchmarks carry no cost, so alpha is net-vs-gross (the conservative side).
definitions.curve_2: Daily equal weights across active rules-4 paper episodes, gross benchmark exposure matched to each episode entry basis and holding interval; entry/exit costs apply to stocks. Any missing required price makes cumulative wealth unknown from that point until data resolve and the series is recomputed. Mixed/legacy series are withheld; original calc-1 values are retained as explicitly unverified legacy comparisons.
definitions.daily_hash_reconciliation: A daily line digests the ENTIRE day: sha256 of the sorted record_sha256 values of every r17_recs record with that (tier, run, date), joined by newline. A tail always ships whole days, never part of one. The check runs AFTER merging the incoming file into the stored records: the digest, n_records and n_recs must match the merged day, and every rec-day must have a daily line.
definitions.delivery_immutability: r17_recs, r17_episodes, r17_daily_hashes and r17_corrections are append-only: a key, once delivered, never disappears. A block with complete=true is the ENTIRE upstream store for that dataset and must contain every previously delivered key (an omitted historical row refuses the whole file; the last good store stands). A block with complete=false is a tail and only adds or upserts. Immutability is identical under both.
definitions.drawdown_runup: Over daily CLOSES from the entry bar to the earlier of the last bar and the 120-day bar: max_drawdown_pct = min(close/entry - 1), max_runup_pct = max(close/entry - 1), gross of costs. Never positive / never negative respectively (0 if never breached).
definitions.entry_price: same_open: official open of rec_date. same_close: official close of rec_date. next_open: official open of the next trading day. A rec frozen on a non-trading day (weekend or holiday build) enters at the open of the first trading day after it (entry_basis_effective=next_session_open). Taken from the split-adjusted daily series at calculation time; ref_price is the raw price frozen with the rec and is display-only.
definitions.episode: Per run and ticker. Consecutive rec-days form one episode opened on the FIRST rec-day; later rec-days increment days_as_rec and open nothing. A NEW episode opens only after the name was out of the rec state for at least 5 captured trading days.
definitions.equity_curve: Per tier, runs combined. Index 100 on the first entry date. Each episode is held from its entry bar through its 60-day bar. Day return of an episode: entry day = close/entry - 1 (0 for a close entry) less the entry cost; later days = close/prev close - 1; the exit cost is charged on the last held day. Curve day return = simple mean over episodes held that day (0 when none). SPY index: close-to-close over the same dates.
definitions.hit: alpha_spy_pp > 0 at the horizon. hit_rate_pct = hits / matured.
definitions.matured: A horizon is matured when its target SPY bar exists at calculation time. Otherwise status=open and the result is a mark to the last common close; open results are never counted in a rate.
definitions.min_sample: A rate or mean is displayable only when matured episodes >= 30 AND distinct names >= 15 AND distinct entry dates >= 10 (meets_min_sample).
definitions.missing_price: Target bar absent for the name but present for SPY: carry the last close up to 3 trading days back (price_carried=true). No bar within that window: status=unresolved, results null. A name with no bar for 5 trading days is unresolved for every later horizon.
definitions.publication_cutoff: pre-open recs are frozen by the morning build; pre-close recs by the pre-close capture. A record captured after 09:25 ET (pre-open) or 15:50 ET (pre-close) gets entry_basis=next_open. Otherwise entry_basis is same_open / same_close.
definitions.rec: Book-neutral entry rec: conviction band Buy or Strong buy, not suspended, conviction and narrative not stale, a timing signal (BUY_DIP or ACCUMULATE), and no NAME-SPECIFIC gate block. Portfolio-dependent gate legs and position sizing are ignored by construction.
definitions.rec_rules_2: Future live captures use public-decision-2: explicit completed name checks, fresh selection and timing. Missing or failed checks cannot authorize a rec. Private gates and sizing are excluded before public evaluation. Rules-1 historical records retain their original definition; aggregate all-version results are descriptive mixtures, not one stable strategy.
definitions.rec_rules_3: Rules-2 public eligibility with financial-inputs-2a-2026-09-20: unshifted Altman Z-double-prime with aligned complete inputs and producer-selected valuation anchor consumption. Unversioned/older matrices cannot authorize a new capture. Rules-1/2 records and hashes are unchanged; versions are separate strategy cohorts.
definitions.rec_rules_4: Rules-3 certified financial inputs with session-only re-entry and calculation version 2. Rules-1/2/3 episode identities and numerical calculation definitions stay version 1.
definitions.trading_days: The trading calendar is the set of dates with a SPY daily bar. The entry bar is day 0. Horizon N is the CLOSE of the N-th SPY bar after the entry bar.
